CH57x Macropad Config Editor

Visual editor for ch57x-keyboard-tool mapping files. Build a layout, copy or download the YAML, then run validate and upload with the CLI.

Keyboard

Count the rows and columns of keys on your keyboard with it in normal orientation (knobs on the right).

Layers & layout

  • Click a button or knob action to edit it.
  • Amber outline = warning, red = invalid.
  • R1 C1 = row 1, column 1 of the button grid, counted from the top left (R2 C3 = row 2, column 3, and so on).
  • On each knob, ↺ ccw = turn counter-clockwise, ● press = push the knob in, ↻ cw = turn clockwise.

Action

Keyboard / media builder

Up to 5 chords per action. Media keys can't take modifiers or be mixed with normal keys. Letters are physical QWERTY keys, not characters.

Mouse builder

Uses the modifier toggles on the left, but mouse actions only support ctrl, shift and alt. Move, drag and wheel values range from -127 to 127.

YAML

./ch57x-keyboard-tool validate mapping.yaml
./ch57x-keyboard-tool upload mapping.yaml
# Linux without udev rules: prefix with sudo
# If your build reads the config from stdin instead: ./ch57x-keyboard-tool upload < mapping.yaml

Upload to keyboard (WebHID)

Writes the mapping above straight to the keyboard from this page (Chrome or Edge on desktop; the keyboard must be connected by USB cable). Packet formats come from ch57x-programmer. Supports ch57x-1 (1189:8840, 1189:8842), ch57x-2 (1189:8890) and ch57x-3 (514c:8850); the model: line in the YAML is filled in from the connected keyboard. 514c:8850 is shared by two different keyboards, so the protocol follows your layout: 16 buttons is the 4×4 pad, any other layout is the 12-key, 4-knob pad (protocol from ch57x-keyboard-tool-enhanced; there a click cannot carry a modifier, the wheel moves one step, and drag is unavailable). Empty actions are skipped, so whatever is on the keyboard for those keys stays unchanged.

Fallback: upload script for the CLI

If WebHID isn't available (Firefox, Safari, or your OS doesn't expose the interface), this generates a script that writes mapping.yaml, runs validate, and only then runs upload with the original tool.

Put the script next to the tool, or give the tool's full path. Linux/macOS: chmod +x upload-ch57x.sh && ./upload-ch57x.sh. Windows: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File upload-ch57x.ps1 (needs USBDK installed).

Import existing YAML

The importer reads the mapping format used by the tool (model, orientation, rows, columns, knobs, layers). Comments are dropped when the file is re-exported.

Reference: actions, LEDs, limitations

Keyboard. a, enter, ctrl-c, cmd-alt-escape. Modifiers: ctrl shift alt/opt win/cmd and right-hand variants rctrl rshift ralt/ropt rwin/rcmd. Sequences use commas: win-r,c,m,d,enter. Raw HID codes: <101>. Option prefix: {delay(100)}left,a,right. Run show-keys for the full key list.

Mouse. click, click(left+right), rclick, mclick, move(x,y), drag(button,x,y), wheel(n), wheelup, wheeldown, with ctrl / shift / alt only.

Media. screenbrightnessup screenbrightnessdown next previous/prev stop play mute volumeup volumedown favorites calculator screenlock webpagehome webpageback webpageforward

LEDs (separate CLI command, not part of the YAML). 0x8840 / 0x8842: led <layer> <mode>… with modes off, backlight, shock, shock2, press and colors red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple (backlight also white). 0x8890: led 1.

3×1 + 1 knob boards: modifiers work on the first key of a sequence only.

Key names outside the ones this editor knows get a warning, not an error, because the tool's own list (show-keys) is authoritative. Always finish with validate.
